allowedRoots.explanation: Environment-owned local agent state may be absent, ignored, or untracked, but it must never contain the deprecated .agents/skills adapter.
Workspace-specific Annifity artifacts are runtime state and must remain ignored.
Project-local Claude adapters are generated outputs that remain tracked for distribution.
The Claude plugin manifest is repository integration metadata and remains tracked.
Project-local Codex adapters are generated outputs that remain tracked for distribution.
Project-local Cursor rules are generated outputs that remain tracked for distribution.
Git owns this internal directory; the doctor checks repository identity but not its contents.
Repository hook sources are canonical integration files and remain tracked.
GitHub workflows, instructions, and generated project-local adapters remain tracked.
Shared Annifity references are canonical source and must be tracked, not treated as runtime output.
The documentation site and catalog are canonical tracked source; ignored docs/audits and docs/roadmaps descendants do not make the docs root disposable.
End-to-end examples are canonical tracked product-builder guidance.
Installed dependencies are reproducible runtime material and must remain ignored.
Top-level skill packages are canonical source and must remain tracked.
Fixtures and verification assets are canonical tracked source and must never be hidden by runtime ignore rules.
Repository build, sync, validation, and doctor tools are canonical tracked source.

forbiddenPaths.explanation: The deprecated duplicate adapter root must not return; .codex/skills is the explicit Codex surface.
Legacy SDCoreJS runtime state is outside the Annifity repository contract and must not be stored at the root.
